vulnerabilities.description: Path traversal vulnerability in gorilla/mux router
vulnerabilities.remediation: Update github.com/gorilla/mux to version 1.8.1 or later

vulnerabilities.description: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in axios HTTP client
vulnerabilities.remediation: Update axios to version 1.6.7 or later

vulnerabilities.description: Prototype pollution in lodash utility library
vulnerabilities.remediation: Update lodash to version 4.17.21 or later

vulnerabilities.description: Heap buffer overflow in curl URL parsing

vulnerabilities.description: Remote code execution in git clone operation
